3.1. Pre-processing We present a uniﬁed format for formulating all types of training samples of SHI and CI by extending the format given in Liao et al. First, we change various punc- tuations between lines into the comma ‘,’, serving as a uni- form separation label between two lines. Second, we utilize three separation labels, [label1] and [label2] to separate be- tween form, title, and body of the poem respectively, and [label3] to separate two stanzas of CI if needed.
